facts.fact: Supersedes F612: the bond ends on day 35 at the Meadow Cairn; Shilak's thaw comes on day 56, three weeks and a day later, consistent with F435; the queen arrives three days after, and the hill council's pairs cross the Saddle for the council at the cairn.
Supersedes F616: Queen Sarala read the archive at her crowning and read Harish's name on its list, but has never dared read what is written under the mountain; she has reigned thirty-one winters.
As the price of the broken oath, the queen strips Ila of the Chief Surveyor's commission, giving it to another, and removes her name from the crown roll; Ila accepts it in one line.
Meera is bound to a Kuhl farmer on the last crossing pair to the council; Roop is bound to Old Bhim and Chand to a terrace woman.
